uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6972-7841-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Darksteel Angel
When Darksteel Angel dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its static effect.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead
Repeat.

2173-4574-5226-7435--44.description:
Sacrifice the templated artifact.
Resolve the ability of your sacrifice outlet.
Remove a +1/+1 counter from Arcbound Reclaimer, putting the artifact on top of your library.
Your leaves-the-graveyard effect triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Cast the templated artifact for 0 life through Bolas's Citadel.
Repeat.
2173-4574-5226-7435--44.notes:
This combo will only result in creature ETB/LTB/etc. if the chosen card from the template is an artifact creature, in which case creature-specific sacrifice outlets may also be used.
For artifacts from the template that can sacrifice themselves, the free sacrifice outlet is unnecessary.

1418-2226-5125.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
1418-2226-5125.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Virtue of Knowledge.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Sparkcaster by paying its mana cost.
When Sparkcaster enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

4881-5396-6909-8200.manaNeeded: {3}{U}{B}{R} plus {2}{B} if Activated Sleeper is in your hand
4881-5396-6909-8200.description:
Cast Trickery Charm by paying {U}, causing Carnage to become a Goblin until end of turn
Cast Grub's Command by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Carnage.
Put the nontoken Carnage into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Carnage token enters, it triggers, putting Activated Sleeper from your graveyard onto the battlefield, or another applicable card otherwise.
If Activated Sleeper was not returned in step 3, cast it by paying {2}{B}. Regardless, choose to have Activated Sleeper enter as a copy of Carnage.
Put Activated Sleeper into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Activated Sleeper enters, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Carnage.
Repeat from step 5.

1115-3490-5477-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature token that has not been tapped this turn.
1115-3490-5477-7075.description:
Activate a creature token by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

1308-3129-4826-6753-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Archelos.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

3967-4681-5170-7918.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Sifa Grent triggers, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Sifa Grent trigger.
Resolve the Sifa Grent trigger, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

1491-5268-6218-7741.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

2034-2048-4871-7147-7646.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Epitaph Golem by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to Krallenhorde Howler.
Repeat.

uses.n: Etali, Primal Conqueror // Etali, Primal Sickness

2178-4147-4294-6798.easyPrerequisites:
Hua Tuo does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Hua Tuo.
2178-4147-4294-6798.description:
Cast Etali by paying {5}{R}{R} and paying any commander tax if relevant.
When Etali enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Etali.
If Etali is your commander, choose not to return it to the command zone from your graveyard.
When Etali dies, Hua Tuo triggers, untapping Hua Tuo.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability from Step 3.
Activate Hua Tuo by tapping it, putting Etali on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Etali trigger from step 2, causing you to exile cards from each player's library until you exile a nonland card, with you exiling Etali from your library.
Cast Etali and any other nonland cards exiled this way without paying their mana costs.
Repeat from Step 2.

813-1987-7089.notablePrerequisites: You control three permanents that enter untapped and that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
813-1987-7089.description:
Declare Fire Lord Azula as an attacker, triggering its firebending ability, adding {R}{R}.
Holding priority, activate three permanents by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, targeting the tapped permanent and Scholar of the Ages.
Fire Lord Azula triggers, copying Ghostly Flicker, targeting two other mana-producing permanents
Resolve the copy of Ghostly Flicker, blinking the two targeted permanents.
Resolve the original Ghostly Flicker, blinking the targeted permanent and Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

1268-1902.notablePrerequisites: There are at least four Elves on the battlefield.
1268-1902.description:
Activate Wirewood Channeler by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Crab Umbra by paying {2}{U}, untapping Wirewood Channeler.
Repeat.

3750-7016-7019.easyPrerequisites: You and an opponent each control a creature.
3750-7016-7019.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Firebending Student.
3750-7016-7019.description:
Cast The Last Agni Kai by paying {1}{R}.
Declare Firebending Student as an attacker, triggering its ability, adding an amount of {R} equal to its power.
Move to your postcombat main phase. You will not lose the mana due to The Last Agni Kai.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

710-1052-2292.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Danitha.
When Danitha dies, Minion's Return triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Minion's Return from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

1829-2034-3097-3490.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Vindictive Vampire triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent and causing you to gain 1 life.
Lisette triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers for each counter placed this way.
Resolve the first trigger, choosing to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve all other triggers, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.

1806-3002-4050-5465.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Eternal Scourge, adding {1}.
Eternal Scourge is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard due to Rest in Peace.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {1}.
Repeat.

215-2092-4617-4758.notablePrerequisites: Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 1 or greater.
215-2092-4617-4758.description:
Activate Soulbright Flamekin three times by paying {3}, adding eight {R}.
Activate Crossroads Candleguide by paying {1}, adding {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {G}, returning Soulbright Flamekin to your hand from the battlefield.
Cast Soulbright Flamekin by paying {1}{R}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Agatha of the Vile Cauldron's ability.

2178-4659-4917.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Jan Jansen.
You control at least one additional noncreature artifact.
2178-4659-4917.description:
Activate Jan Jansen's second ability by tapping it and sacrificing another noncreature artifact, creating two 1/1 Construct artifact creature tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Construct, adding {C}{C}.
The Construct dies, triggering Jan Jansen, untapping Jan Jansen.
Activate Jan Jansen's first ability by tapping it and sacrificing the remaining Construct.
The Construct dies, triggering Jan Jansen, untapping Jan Jansen.
Resolve the Jan Jensen ability, creating two Treasure tokens.
Repeat.

624-3518-3605-5131.description:
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Phantasmal Image from your graveyard by paying {U}{U}.
Phantasmal Image enters the battlefield as a copy of Muldrotha, putting original Muldrotha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
 Cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Cast Dance of the Dead from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}, targeting Muldrotha.
Muldrotha enters the battlefield, putting Phantasmal Image into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
